fleet.description: one production fleet running a data business: scrapers, refreshes, health checks, report builders and a handful of LLM jobs

kind_meaning.BUDGET_DAY: one agent went over its daily cost cap
kind_meaning.BUDGET_RUN: one run went over its cost cap
kind_meaning.DRIFT: cost or duration moved away from this job's own baseline, while nothing failed
kind_meaning.FAILED: exited non-zero, or the client reported failure
kind_meaning.MISSED: the run never started: dead scheduler, expired auth, crash before the first line
kind_meaning.NO_EVIDENCE: reported success, but the file, URL or assertion it promised was missing
kind_meaning.RETRY_STORM: the same tool with the same input, over and over, inside one run
kind_meaning.STALLED: started and then stopped reporting before it ended

limits: One fleet, not an industry average.
Mostly small scheduled jobs; the median run takes about a second.
The record is what each client reported: a client that misreports its own cost produces a faithful record of the misreport.
A job nobody registered produces no alerts, so unmonitored work is invisible here by definition.
